brand_identity.name: Fastlane
brand_identity.tagline: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI
brand_identity.description: Fastlane is an AI marketing agent for brands. Its agent Senna learns a brand from a link, studies competitors and customers, builds campaigns, creates ads and organic content, launches across Meta, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, and doubles down on what works.

business_positioning.category: AI marketing / social content automation platform
business_positioning.business_model: SaaS subscription with credit-based usage, plus paid warmed social accounts
business_positioning.market_position: Positions itself as an end-to-end AI marketing agent built by marketers who have run $1B+ in ad spend
business_positioning.positioning_statement: Fastlane is the AI marketing agent for brands: give Senna a URL and it learns the brand, creates ads and organic content in volume, publishes across Meta, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn, and scales the winners.
differentiators: Learns a brand from a single URL and scans past ads to identify what works
Combines creation, native publishing, attribution and iteration in one loop
Developer API and MCP server let agents run marketing autonomously
Sells warmed US/EU TikTok and Instagram accounts as distribution surface
1,000+ AI UGC characters plus 2,000+ licensed human UGC videos
